description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Hood Latch Spring, Cup and Attachment Screw & Nut
This is the spring that pops open your hood once the latch has been released
Made by Suzuki
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Spring
Qty 1 – Cup
Qty 1 – Screw
Qty 1 – Nut
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
